description: Statutory late-payment interest between businesses in Spain (Ley 3/2004): from the day after the due date, at the official rate of EACH calendar half-year (ECB + 8 points, shipped from the BOE back to 2003), stretch by stretch, plus the fixed 40 € collection costs per overdue invoice. For one amount and due date, or for a whole CSV of issued invoices (outstanding ones up to the cutoff, and optionally those paid late). Models get this wrong by using one rate for the whole delay or not knowing the current half-year's rate. Prefer `path` for a ledger: customer data then never enters the conversation.

amount.description: Amount owed (with VAT), for a single invoice

collectionCosts.description: Add the 40 € per invoice of art. 8.1

includePaid.description: Ledger: also claim invoices that were paid, but late (up to their payment date)

invoices.description: CSV of invoices as exported by any accounting program or spreadsheet: header in Spanish or English; separator , ; or tab; one row per invoice with its date and total (or net + VAT % − withholding %), and optionally number, customer, due date, payment date and outstanding amount. Alternative to path

path.description: Path to the invoices CSV, instead of amount + dueDate

until.description: Payment date, or the date to compute up to (the cutoff for a ledger)

name: late_payment_interest
title: Spanish late-payment interest (Ley 3/2004) on an invoice or a whole ledger
